title: After the rune exhaust (energy now 2), the engine offers `activateAbility` for the legend Herald of the Arcane ('[1], [Exhaust]: Play a 1 Might Recruit unit token') and the UI shows an 'Activate Ability - Herald of the Arcane' button, while a Showdown is open at Abandoned Hall with player-1 holding Focus.
expected: Trace step 30/31 shows showdown active at player-1-bf-unl-205-219 with focusPlayer=player-1, chain null (showdown-open), and moves includes activateAbility for player-1-legend-ogn-265-298; DOM shows 'Activate Ability Herald of the Arcane'. Card def (riftbound-cards/src/cards/ogn/herald-of-the-arcane.ts:17-25) declares the ability with no keyword/timing. activate-ability.ts:39-50 `abilityTimingClass` returns 'action' for any non-gear host lacking Action/Reaction keyword (line 49: `getCardType(hostCardId) === "gear" ? "standard" : "action"`), and chain-state.ts:208 `isLegalTiming('action')` returns true for 'showdown-open'. Both condition (line 514-515) and enumerator (858-862) use this, so the keyword-less legend ability is offered mid-showdown. This contradicts rules 313.1.a, 308.1.a ('Only cards and abilities with the Action or Reaction keywords can be played or activated in a Showdown State') and 343.1.b ('Card abilities, by default, cannot be played during a Showdown State'); only gear (151.2) is correctly restricted, while 145.2/legend abilities get the wrong default.
